idea: Long-horizon return forecasts from machine-learning combinations of firm characteristics (Gu, Kelly and Xiu 2020) capture slower-moving premia than short-term forecasts.
rationale_data: long_term_120d_regression_prediction (multi factor market return predictions, model category): a regression forecast of the 120-day return.
rationale_operators: rank() keeps the ordering of the forecast; subindustry neutralization removes industry bets.

idea: Analyst information (revisions, surprises, dispersion) predicts returns over several months as prices absorb it slowly (Chan, Jegadeesh and Lakonishok 1996).
rationale_data: analyst_120d_regression_pred (multi factor market return predictions, model category): a 120-day return forecast from analyst features.
rationale_operators: rank() normalises the forecast; subindustry neutralization removes industry bets.

idea: Long-horizon quantile forecasts from many signal sources (Gu, Kelly and Xiu 2020) diversify away from short-term price effects.
rationale_data: long_term_quantile1_120d_pred (multi-source market return prediction, model category): predicted quantile probability for the 120-day return.
rationale_operators: rank() normalises the probability across stocks; subindustry neutralization removes industry effects.

idea: Analyst-based forecasts of longer-horizon returns: analyst information diffuses over months (Womack 1996; Chan, Jegadeesh and Lakonishok 1996).
rationale_data: analyst_quantile1_120d_pred (multi-source market return prediction, model category).
rationale_operators: rank() normalises the probability; subindustry neutralization removes industry effects.

idea: Jiang, Kelly and Xiu (2023): image-based models of market data predict returns; this one forecasts the 50-day return from option-chart images.
rationale_data: predicted_stock_return_50d_image (option chart image return prediction, model category).
rationale_operators: rank() normalises the forecast; subindustry neutralization removes industry trends.

idea: Jiang, Kelly and Xiu (2023), (Re-)Imag(in)ing Price Trends: CNN forecasts from price-chart images predict 30-day returns.
rationale_data: img30d_return_quintile (deep learning chart-based alpha, model category): predicted 30-day return quintile.
rationale_operators: rank() turns the quintile into a cross-sectional score; subindustry neutralization removes industry trends.

idea: Givoly and Lakonishok (1979); Chan, Jegadeesh and Lakonishok (1996): frequent and large upward earnings-estimate updates predict outperformance.
rationale_data: analyst_earnings_revision_score_6 (AI equity alpha forecasts, model category): frequency and magnitude of analyst earnings-estimate updates.
rationale_operators: vec_avg() aggregates the vector field; rank() normalises; industry neutralization compares within industries.

idea: Beneish (1999) and Piotroski (2000): forensic accounting scores that flag financial trouble or strength predict future returns.
rationale_data: accounting_forensics_factor (AI equity alpha forecasts, model category): analysis of the accounts for signs of financial trouble or strength.
rationale_operators: vec_avg() aggregates the vector field; rank() normalises; industry neutralization removes industry accounting norms.

idea: Revision momentum (Chan, Jegadeesh and Lakonishok 1996), measured as a percentile of the magnitude and direction of estimate revisions over a medium horizon.
rationale_operators: rank() normalises the score; industry neutralization compares within industries.

idea: Conrad, Dittmar and Ghysels (2013), Ex Ante Skewness and Expected Stock Returns: option-implied skewness predicts subsequent returns.
rationale_data: Option-implied expected upward and downward moves (percent of price) from the equity expected move dataset (model category); their difference measures implied skewness.
rationale_operators: The difference is an implied-skew proxy; rank() normalises it; industry neutralization removes industry volatility levels.

idea: Implied volatility that is high relative to its own history signals fear that tends to be followed by underperformance (Ang, Hodrick, Xing and Zhang 2006 on volatility and returns).
rationale_data: implied_volatility_30d_percentile_long_term (option horizon decomposition, model category): where today's 30-day implied volatility sits within its past year.
rationale_operators: rank() normalises the percentile and the minus sign shorts stocks with unusually high implied volatility; industry neutralization removes industry effects.

idea: Boehmer, Jones and Zhang (2008), Which Shorts Are Informed?: changes in short-selling activity carry information about future returns.
rationale_data: shrt7_combo_deltaactivity (short selling model, model category): normalised time-series change in units, tickets and utilisation of stock loans.
rationale_operators: vec_avg() aggregates the vector field; rank() normalises; industry neutralization compares within industries.
